This directory contains the unmodified official testlib header used by Newjudge
Studio. Native `linteractive` also ships an identical copy at
`ljudge/etc/ljudge/_default/testlib.h`. The legacy `include/testlib.h` remains
unchanged.

- Upstream: https://github.com/MikeMirzayanov/testlib
- Pinned commit: `1e4e8a24c79c6bad3becbdb5a332ffc352b7d5dd`
- Source: https://github.com/MikeMirzayanov/testlib/blob/1e4e8a24c79c6bad3becbdb5a332ffc352b7d5dd/testlib.h
- Downloaded using the official GitHub contents API. The license is embedded at
  the beginning of the header.

The browser libraries and their license files live in `static/vendor/`.
Their exact versions and integrity hashes are recorded in `package-lock.json`.
